title: Too expensive!
subtitle: No trip home, but a new plan — too and enough
canDo: I can say what the problem is with too and not … enough.
I can explain a change of plans.
I can say yes to a new idea: Why don't you …? — I'd love to.
teacherNotes: too / very ayrımı Türk ve Arap öğrenciler için zor: Türkçede ikisi de "çok", Arapçada "جدًّا". "too = bir sorun var" kuralını tahtaya yazın.
Saat farkı detayı: İzmir'de gece yarısı olduğunda Boston'da saat 17.00. Öğrencilere kendi ülkeleriyle aradaki farkı sorun.
Rol oyunu: plan değişikliği. A: "Would you like to …?" B: "I'm afraid I can't. It's too …" A: "Why don't we … instead?"
ABD'de round-trip ticket, İngiltere'de return ticket denir.

sections.heading: Bad news, good news
sections.scene: The next Monday, in the school break.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: So, Elif, did you look at the tickets?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Yes, I did. A round-trip ticket to Izmir costs fourteen hundred dollars!

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: I know. I'm saving money, but I don't have enough. I only work two days a week.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: That's a pity. Are you disappointed?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: A little. I'm going to miss our family dinner on New Year's Eve.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Hey, I have an idea! Why don't you come to New York with us? There's an extra seat in Jake's car.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Really? But New York hotels are too expensive for me too.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: We're going to stay at my cousin's apartment. It's small, but it's free!

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Is it big enough for five people?

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Well … no. But it's warm enough, and my cousin makes great coffee.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Then I'd love to come. I'm going to see New York!

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: A change of plans
sections.intro: Elif writes to her parents that evening.
paragraphs: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to come home this winter. The tickets are too expensive, and I don't have enough money yet.
Please don't be sad! I have a new plan. Lucas and his band are going to play three concerts in New York, and they invited me.
We're going to leave on December 22nd in Jake's car, and we're going to stay at Lucas's cousin's apartment.
I'm going to see the big bookstores and the old buildings. You know me: I'm going to draw everything!
On New Year's Eve, I'm going to call you at midnight. Your midnight, not mine! It's only five in the afternoon here then.
I'm going to save money every month, and next summer I'm going to come home for four weeks. That's a promise.
Give Pamuk a kiss from me.

sections.title: Grammar: too and enough
look: Is it **big enough** for five people?

head: Example
Meaning
rows: more than you want: a problem
less than you need: a problem

rules: **too** goes before the adjective: **too** cold, **too** expensive.
**enough** goes after an adjective (big **enough**) but before a noun (**enough** money).
Use *very* when there's no problem: *Boston is **very** beautiful.* (not too beautiful)
examples: This coat is too big for me.
The café isn't big enough for a concert.

support.tr: too + sıfat = fazla, aşırı (bir sorun var): too expensive = çok pahalı (alamam). enough = yeterli: sıfattan sonra gelir (big enough = yeterince büyük), isimden önce gelir (enough money = yeterli para). Dikkat: Türkçedeki "çok" bazen very, bazen too'dur. Sorun yoksa very: very beautiful = çok güzel.
support.ar: too + صفة = أكثر من اللازم (توجد مشكلة): too expensive = غالٍ جدًّا (لا أستطيع شراءه). و enough = كافٍ: تأتي بعد الصفة (big enough = كبير بما يكفي) وقبل الاسم (enough money = مال كافٍ). انتبه: «جدًّا» بالعربية قد تكون very أو too؛ إذا لم تكن هناك مشكلة نستخدم very: very beautiful.

tr.note: "çok" = very (sorun yok) veya too (sorun var). enough sıfattan sonra gelir.

ar.note: enough تأتي قبل الاسم، و too ليست للمدح.
